summary: WPP plc filed a Form 6-K for July 2026. The filing is a notification of its 2026 interim results and contains standard forward-looking statements and risk factors. It does not relate to any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a routine earnings-related report by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms are present.
